in_sanskrit.name: श्राबन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Shraban is derived from the Sanskrit word श्राबन (shrāban), which means 'Flowing or Streaming'. This name is often given to a baby boy born during the monsoon season when the rivers and water sources are in full flow.

in_hindi.name: श्राबन
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Shraban श्राबन in Hindi means 'Natural Stream' or 'Flowing River'. This name is often given to a baby boy born during the monsoon season when the rivers and water sources are in full flow.

in_tamil.name: ஷ்ராபன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Shraban ஷ்ராபன் in Tamil language means 'One who nourishes like a river'. This name is derived from the Tamil word குழந்தையாக்கு (kuzhndaiyakku), which means 'nourishing'.

in_telugu.name: శ్రాబన్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Shraban శ్రాబన్ in Telugu language means 'One who is the lord of all'. This name is derived from the Telugu word ప్రభవ్యోదేశ (prabhavyodhesham), which means 'lord of all'.

in_marathi.name: Shraban
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shraban हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word Shravan meaning to hear, listen or perceive. This name is associated with the month of Sharvan in the Hindu calendar, which falls during the autumn season and is characterized by heavy rains.
